cellIndex.description: The index at which to insert the cell.

code.description: The code content of the new cell.

language.description: The programming language of the new cell.

cellIndexEnd.description: The end index for the cell range (inclusive). This must be greater than or equal to cellIndexStart. If not provided, this defaults to the last available cell index.

cellIndexStart.description: The starting index for the cell range (inclusive). If not provided, this defaults to 0.

includeOutputs.description: Whether to include the code cell execution outputs in the response. If not provided, this defaults to false.

cellId.description: The ID of the code cell to execute.
